propositions: Four rendered advanced CLI parser factories (metrics, audit, bridge-fsck, bridge-probe) use stock argparse.HelpFormatter with width-78 instead of RebarHelpFormatter with fixed width-80, causing help-artifact width inconsistency and py3.13 divergence risk.

py3.13 argparse help-rendering changes (option metavar format, subparser usage wrapping) would silently stale the committed help artifacts on py3.13-only CI without version-pinned formatter, replicating the RP-05 S2d regression.
Help-backed (rendered) routes must all use RebarHelpFormatter subclass to ensure deterministic, version-stable help generation across py3.11/3.12/3.13.
Contract test iterating help-backed route registry must fail if any parser factory uses a formatter not subclassing RebarHelpFormatter, preventing future reintroduction of the trap.
Regenerating bridge-fsck help artifact to canonical width-80 form is the only committed byte change; metrics/audit/bridge-probe have no wrapping help and remain byte-identical.
